body:
Tested locally, it works as expected. This brings a slight performance improvement to `StringName.length()` from GDScript, which is consistently reproducible across runs.

```
BEFORE: StringName.length() 100000000 iterations: 1190795 usecs
AFTER: StringName.length() 100000000 iterations: 1162713 usecs

For comparison (same before and after): String.length() 100000000 iterations: 451700 usecs
```

On the other hand, release optimized stripped binaries (with LTO) are almost 600 KB larger now:

```
71,982,712  godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64.master
72,539,832  godot.linuxbsd.template_release.x86_64
```

I'm not sure what would be causing this.
